Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: follow a colonist
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on your colonists makes the camera follow them around the map until you turn it off.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: extra game speed
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A key (Shift+4 by default) toggles a fourth, faster game speed for long trips between stars.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: detailed date and days to rot
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Hovering the date shows the full date and hour, the day of the year and days since landing. Items that rot show how many days they have left in their info card.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: temperature gauge
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A small gauge you can build that shows the temperature of its room right on the map.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: continue button
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Adds a Continue button to the main menu that loads your most recent save.

ThingDef.label: temperature gauge
ThingDef.description: A small thermometer on a post. It shows the temperature of its room right on the map.
